# REST API Requirements Quality Checklist: Quick Consult Credit

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of the REST API requirements (balance retrieval and transaction creation) before implementation planning proceeds.
**Created**: 2026-09-15
**Feature**: [credit-rest-api.md](../credit-rest-api.md) (primary), [contracts/rest-api.md](../contracts/rest-api.md), [clarifications.md](../clarifications.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are validation requirements defined for malformed or missing required request fields (e.g., missing `customer_id`, missing `transaction_type`) distinct from the `INVALID_AMOUNT` case? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements defined for the system's behavior when `transaction_type` is a value outside the four defined enum values? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements defined for non-numeric or malformed `customerId` path parameters on the balance endpoint? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK004 Is a rate-limiting or throttling requirement defined for either endpoint, or is its absence an explicit decision? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK005 Are request payload size/field-length constraints specified (e.g., maximum `message` length)? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK006 Is an API versioning/backward-compatibility requirement defined for future breaking changes beyond `V1`? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK007 Does the specification define whether the create-transaction endpoint accepts transaction types other than `REDEEM` (e.g., `PURCHASE`, `ADMIN_ADD`, `ADMIN_REMOVE`), or is it scoped exclusively to redemption? [Completeness, Spec §Endpoint: Create Transaction]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 Is the exact HTTP status code for a successful create-transaction response specified as a single value, rather than "200/201"? [Clarity, Spec §QCC-API-010]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the exact HTTP status code for `INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE` fixed, rather than qualified with "e.g."? [Clarity, Spec §Error Contract Detail]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the exact response field names for previous/current balance fixed as a single normative name, rather than "or equivalently named"? [Clarity, Spec §QCC-API-010]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "the specific authorization category that granted or denied access is determinable" (QCC-API-011) defined with an observable, externally verifiable mechanism, or is it only an internal design aspiration? [Clarity, Measurability, Spec §QCC-API-011]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the data type and valid range for `amount` (e.g., integer only, rejecting decimal/fractional input) explicitly stated as a request-validation rule? [Clarity, Spec §QCC-API-006]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 Are the response field names in the normative specification (`credit-rest-api.md`) consistent with the concrete field names in the design contract (`contracts/rest-api.md`), or does one need to be reconciled into the other? [Consistency, Conflict, Spec §QCC-API-010 vs. contracts/rest-api.md Endpoint 2]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the balance endpoint's authorization model (customer self-access permitted) consistent between the normative requirement (QCC-API-009) and the design contract's authorization row? [Consistency, Spec §QCC-API-009]
- [ ] CHK015 Are the standardized error payload fields (`success`, `error_code`, `message`) consistently required across both endpoints' error scenarios, including the balance endpoint's 401/403/404 cases? [Consistency, Spec §QCC-API-012]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality / Measurability

- [ ] CHK016 Can QCC-API-011's requirement to distinguish authentication, authorization, customer ownership, integration authorization, and admin authorization be objectively verified from an external response, or only from internal logs/design? [Measurability, Spec §QCC-API-011]
- [ ] CHK017 Does QCC-API-013 (replay/idempotency) have a measurable acceptance criterion for the case of two simultaneous (not sequential) duplicate requests, or only for a request "resubmitted" after the first completes? [Measurability, Gap, Spec §QCC-API-013]
- [ ] CHK018 Is "no duplicate balance change or ledger entry results" (QCC-API-013 AC-1) verifiable without a defined request-identity mechanism, given CLA-004 remains open? [Measurability, Ambiguity, Spec §QCC-API-013]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK019 Are primary (success), exception (validation/authorization error), and replay/retry scenarios all defined for the create-transaction endpoint? [Coverage, Spec §Endpoint: Create Transaction]
- [ ] CHK020 Are recovery-flow requirements defined for a client that receives no response due to a network/timeout failure after a request may have already been partially processed? [Coverage, Gap, Exception Flow]
- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements defined for concurrent requests to the balance endpoint occurring during an in-flight balance-changing operation for the same customer (i.e., read-during-write consistency)? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK022 Are requirements defined for a customer-authenticated caller attempting to invoke the create-transaction endpoint (not merely rejected, but is the specific rejection scenario and response distinctly documented)? [Coverage, Spec §QCC-API-005 AC-2]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 Is behavior defined for a `customerId` value of zero, negative, or exceeding the maximum valid customer identifier range? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK024 Is behavior defined when `request_reference` is supplied but the original request it references failed rather than succeeded (does replay protection apply only to successful originals)? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §contracts/rest-api.md Endpoint 2]
- [ ] CHK025 Is behavior defined for an authorized integration/admin caller submitting a redemption request for a customer with an already-zero balance? [Edge Case, Spec §QCC-API-007]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK026 Are response-time or throughput expectations defined for either endpoint, or is the absence explicitly tracked as an open item? [Non-Functional, Spec §clarifications.md CLA-012]
- [ ] CHK027 Are logging/observability requirements for rejected or replayed API requests cross-referenced from this specification, or only implied? [Non-Functional, Spec §audit-and-observability.md]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK028 Is the dependency on a finalized idempotency-key/request-identity contract (CLA-004) clearly flagged as blocking for QCC-API-013 implementation, rather than silently assumed resolved? [Dependency, Spec §clarifications.md CLA-004]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the assumption that integration ACL and admin ACL are the only two authorized caller types for create-transaction (excluding any future third-party consumer class) explicitly documented? [Assumption, Spec §QCC-API-005]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK030 Is the term "business validation failure" in QCC-API-012 (triggering the standardized error payload) clarified to include or exclude authentication/authorization failures (401/403), which are documented separately? [Ambiguity, Spec §QCC-API-012 vs. Error Contract Detail]
- [ ] CHK031 Does the SRS-variant path table entry (retained for traceability only) create a risk of accidental dual implementation, and is a requirement present that explicitly forbids implementing the superseded variant? [Conflict, Spec §QCC-API-014]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
